parsed.notes:
The plus section is optional; Our Stack starts a new, required section. Technologies appearing only in responsibilities or company descriptions are excluded.
Advanced degree names no explicit degree level; the guide's literal unspecified-level rule therefore gives bachelor, not an inferred master or PhD.
Java, TypeScript, Claude Code and GitHub Copilot are independently required by Our Stack, so they do not retain alternative grouping from the qualifications.
LLM orchestration is independently requested in the following qualification; its earlier alternative set has fewer than two mapped members remaining and receives no group.
The framework/protocol examples form alternative group 1. MCP's optional contribution mention is itself part of an alternatives list, not an independent mandatory ask.
Kafka and SQS are alternative examples, but SQS is unmapped, leaving fewer than two taxonomy skills for a group. The same limitation applies to the optional harness/fine-tuning/RLHF-RLAIF alternatives.
Metrics, distributed tracing and structured logging are covered by observability rather than duplicated as unmapped skills. Relational databases do not imply SQL, and RLHF/RLAIF do not add an unnamed broader reinforcement-learning criterion.
